cohort: The study included 48,556 pregnant women attending the delivery room at a tertiary teaching hospital.
finding: A low seroprevalence of hepatitis B and C (0.24% overall, 0.22% for B, 0.02% for C) was found among pregnant women at a tertiary university hospital in Jordan.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, at the time of attending the delivery room between January 2005 and December 2016
